title: Find a substring without built-in contains or indexOf
answer: Use a naive sliding comparison. For every possible starting index in the main String, compare the substring characters one by one. If every character matches, return that start index; if a mismatch occurs, move to the next possible start. AeroTopo's `indexOf` method implements this with nested loops and a labeled `continue`. Its worst-case time complexity is O((n-m+1) · m), commonly simplified to O(nm), with O(1) extra space.
